I have been farming this land near Lake Victoria for many years, and I know what works for me. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or improved seed, and since this plot is rented, I do not want to spend money on inputs I might not recover. My wife and children will help me prepare the land, transplant, weed, and harvest the rice with our hand hoes, just as we always have. We rely on the rains and the natural wetness of this lowland area, and we have no pumps or canals for irrigation.
